lernapps.github.io.message:
feat(site-frame): the frame in the chosen language, the text in the one it exists in

## Intent

The tooling and the platform design exist in English only. Their frame followed the page's own language, so a click on them switched the whole site to English, and with no German page to switch to, there was no way back. Header and footer should stay in the language the reader chose; the text should show in that language where it exists, and otherwise in the one it is available in.

## Key changes

- lernapps-frame copies a page that exists in one language only (the tooling, the platform design, the vision, the organisation), with the files of its folder, into every language tree it is missing from. Each copy gets the frame of its tree and a language switch.
- Links to pages in a copy lead to the same page in its language. The tooling joins the translated sites, so the navigation leads English readers to /tooling/en/; the footer and the English home page link the English copies.
- The frame carries lang on header, footer, skip link and preview banner, so screen readers read it right inside a page in another language.
- lernapps-check accepts a page of the English tree whose frame says lang="en".

## Dependencies and side effects

- lernapps/docs 3dff842, lernapps/tooling e8c5955 and lernapps/apps 4768bcd use the new frame.

docs.message:
fix: the vision, organisation and platform design in the English tree too

## Intent

The vision, the organisation and the platform design exist in English only. Readers who chose English must reach them with an English frame, and readers who chose German must keep a German one.

## Key changes

- The docs use the site frame that copies English-only pages below /docs/en/; the English start page links them there.
- The styling of the single-page app runs before the frame, so the copies get it too.
- The README says so.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs lernapps/lernapps.github.io e87d6a9, which this commit pins.

fix(site): the tooling in every language tree

## Intent

The tooling pages exist in English only. A click on them switched the whole site to English with no way back. They must keep the frame of the language the reader chose.

- The arc42 styling runs before the frame, so the copies get it too.

## Dependencies and side effects

apps.message:
fix(build): the tooling links lead to the tooling in the page's language

## Intent

The tooling now exists in every language tree. The links to it from the app overview must keep the reader in the language of the page.

## Key changes

- A filter turns links to other platform pages into links in the page's language; the build page uses it for its tooling links.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs lernapps/lernapps.github.io e87d6a9, which this commit pins.
